statement: The equation $x=\cos x$ has a root $\alpha$. Using the iteration $x_{n+1}=\cos x_n$ with $x_0=0.7$, find $x_1$ and $x_2$ to 3 decimal places.
solution:
Apply the iteration:
$$x_1=\cos(0.7)\approx0.764842\approx0.765\quad(\text{to 3 d.p.}),$$
$$x_2=\cos(0.764842)\approx0.721488\approx0.721\quad(\text{to 3 d.p.}).$$
So $x_1\approx0.765$ and $x_2\approx0.721$ (the root $\alpha\approx0.739$ to which the iteration converges).
